purpose: Teach: 逆襲/脱落/総統/総督/ゆだね/波乱/バイパス/リバウンド

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場での逆襲を狙え
lines.en: Our company needs to strike back in the market.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding opening. Measured pace. Each clause lands with intent. No softening—this is a directive, not a suggestion. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人の脱落を防ぐ研修を強化します
lines.en: Yes. I'll strengthen our training to prevent new hires from dropping out.
lines.style: Respectful confirmation. Lean-forward attentiveness. Clear, methodical tone—he's already thinking through execution. Crisp on the key commitment word. No unnecessary flourish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外取引先の総統就任にも対応しろ
lines.en: Our company must also respond to the new leadership transition with our overseas partners.
lines.style: Firm, expectation-setting delivery. Slight weight on 'must'—this is non-negotiable. Controlled tempo. Eyes steady. The tone of someone who knows complexity is coming and won't tolerate stumbling.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新総督の任命式に出席します
lines.en: Understood. I'll attend the new governor's inauguration ceremony.
lines.style: Brisk confirmation. Minimal word waste. Businesslike but not cold—he's already taking the action into his hands. Quick, assured nod in the voice. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新規事業を若手にゆだねろ
lines.en: Our company will entrust new ventures to younger staff. Make it happen.
lines.style: Declarative, almost final-sounding. Confidence in the decision itself. Measured but not slow. The implicit trust beneath the command is clear—he means this as opportunity, not just burden.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。波乱含みの市場でも対応します
lines.en: Yes. We'll adapt—even if the market becomes volatile.
lines.style: Assured undertone. Accepting the challenge without drama. Steady, even-keeled delivery. Quiet competence. He's saying 'we can handle this' without needing to prove anything.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 物流のバイパスルートを確保しろ
lines.style: Clipped, economical. Direct as an instruction carved from experience. No elaboration needed. The tone says this matters. Brief, authoritative pause before the next command.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。シェアのリバウンドを狙います
lines.en: Yes. We'll target a rebound in market share.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Quieter than before, but resolute. Closing attitude—this is the last piece, and he's locking it in. Slight upward lilt on 'share,' like seeing the finish line. Professional but earned.
